entities.name: Carth
entities.description: Native of Corondor with the Mark of the Elder Druid, called the Lion of Carth, who founded House Carthalion.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Land on Dominaria where Carth was born.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Evil demon planeswalker who destroyed Carth's hometown.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Dihada's champion who murdered a hundred of Carth's tribesfolk.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Planeswalker summoned to Dominaria by Carth's trick.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: War started by Dakkon's binding to the plane.

entities.name: House Carthalion
entities.description: House founded by Carth on Terisiare.

events.summary: Carth took part in an uprising against Dihada that failed; Sol'Kanar murdered a hundred of his tribesfolk including his mother and sister.
events.quote: Carth was forced to watch as Dihada's champion, Sol'Kanar , murdered one hundred of his tribesfolk

events.summary: Captured, Carth was tricked by a disguised Dihada into summoning and binding Dakkon Blackblade to Dominaria.
events.quote: a disguised Dihada tricked him into summoning Dakkon Blackblade to Dominaria and binding him to the plane

events.summary: Carth and Dakkon escaped Dihada, became friends and traveled to Terisiare, where Carth founded House Carthalion.
events.quote: the son of Carth founded House Carthalion

relations.quote: Carth the Lion took part in an uprising against the evil planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada
